findings.title: Do not unlink SQLite journals based solely on their suffix
findings.evidence: run_cohort_1 unlinks every .db-wal/.db-shm under WORKSPACE and CORTEX_DIR; no connection, checkpoint, liveness or orphan check precedes unlink. main invokes it unconditionally.
findings.trigger: Run this purge while a non-protected SQLite database has committed WAL pages not checkpointed into the main file.
findings.impact: The script can remove durable committed pages and disrupt active database coordination; the comment calling these files orphans does not establish that they are orphaned.

findings.title: Normalize rational ticks before returning them
findings.evidence: from_rational constructs Tick60 directly with seconds unchanged and sexa_units=num*factor, while new normalizes units and sub/derived ordering rely on normalized seconds.
findings.impact: Equivalent durations compare unequal and sub of the former minus the latter incorrectly returns underflow. Use the normalizing constructor and define overflow handling.

findings.title: Reject oversized content or return the exact bytes that were filtered
findings.evidence: evaluate_payload truncates only its local text variable then can return passed=True with truncated=True. browser_agent.py:109-135 accepts passed, stores raw_payload, attests raw_payload and returns raw_payload.
findings.trigger: A fetched payload has an acceptable first MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES characters containing an anchor, followed by content that the filter would reject.
findings.impact: The unexamined suffix is emitted and cached as VERIFIED_AND_ATTESTED; this is a demonstrated source-level consumer mismatch, not a claim about OS containment. Reject oversize data or propagate a filtered payload.

findings.title: Preserve poisoning when the example writer is called again
findings.evidence: write loads any seqlock value and overwrites it with seq+1 then seq+2; poison stores 0xDEAD_6060, but write never checks it.
findings.trigger: In the standalone example, call poison(), then write(), then read().
findings.impact: The supposedly irreversible fail-stop becomes a readable live state. The existing test only reads immediately after poison and misses this transition; no production adoption is asserted.

findings.title: Limit Lean cleanup to verified disposable build products
findings.evidence: The comment scopes cleanup to obsolete caches in archived projects, but traversal covers all WORKSPACE and rmtree removes the complete .lake directory without archive/state checks.
findings.trigger: Run the script with an active unprotected Lean project under ~/10_PROJECTS.
findings.impact: Deletes active fetched dependencies and any local changes under .lake/packages, and removes artifacts needed by subsequent verification. The implementation does not enforce its stated archived-only scope.

findings.title: Label model arithmetic separately from physical thermodynamic evidence
findings.evidence: bits_erased_json=1024*iterations and bits_erased_shm=0 are fixed assumptions; the harness times single-process simulated JSON formatting and local manifest calls, then prints that every thermodynamic invariant passed at line 192.
findings.trigger: Use the PoC output as the evidence promised by its empirical falsification/thermodynamic verdict.
findings.impact: The verdict overstates the actual checks: no physical energy measurement, real IPC transfer, or erasure accounting is performed. Restrict the conclusion to the local example and explicitly declared model assumptions.

hypotheses.observation: FieldPtr is ignored by the checker although it produces an address used by the x86 backend; no internal BorrowChecker caller was found in the compiler subtree.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Clients that check field-address loads may reject valid allocations as UseAfterFree because destination provenance is absent. No runtime bypass claimed; integration and external callers remain unverified.

hypotheses.observation: Quick-start configuration specifies assets.directory but handler references env.ASSETS; no assets.binding is shown.
hypotheses.hypothesis: Example likely requires an explicit ASSETS binding. External current API semantics were not checked, so this remains a documentation hypothesis.
